key_findings: Review: SPMs (resolvins, maresins, protectins, lipoxins) relieve chronic pain by inhibiting TRPV1/TRPA1, glial activation, NF-kB signalling and NMDAR-mediated central sensitization.
SPMs also reduce oxidative stress, e.g. LXA4 increases Nrf2 and 17-oxoDHA activates PPARgamma.
